>>>>CLASSIFIED<<<<< >>>>NO DATA AVAILABLE<<<<<

Augmented (applied): body 4 (5), quickness 5 (7), reaction 5 (9).

Initiative (printed): 5 (9) + 1D6 (3D6)

Bioware: Adrenal Pump (2); Pain Editor; Synthacardium (2); Toxin Exhaler

Cyberware: Air Filter (5); Blood Filter (5) (alpha); Bone Lacing (Plastic) (alpha); Cranial Area Bomb (set to detonate upon death); Cyberears [Balance Augmentor (alpha), Hearing Amplification, Select Sound Filter (3), Sound Damper]; Cybereyes (alpha) (Datajack, Flare Compensation, Low-Light, Thermographic, Optical Scanning Retinal Clock, Rangefinder, Tool Laser) (all alpha); Internal Air Tank; Move-By-Wire System (2) (beta)

Gear: Barret Model 121 [w/28 rounds APDS ammo, Sound Suppressor, Bipod, Level II Smartlink, Imaging Scope (Low-Light, Mag 3), Ruthenium Polymer Case w/6 Imaging Scanners]; Ceska vz/120 (54 round APDS ammo, Silencer, Level II Smartlink); Morrissey Elan (10 rounds APDS ammo); Ruthenium Polymer Armored Suit (Armor 5/2, 6 Imaging Scanners); Shock Glove; Shuriken (6, w/Dikote edge); Survival Knife (w/Dikote edge); Additional gear as appropriate

Note: The book prints the eye list as "Optical Scanning Retinal Clock"; read here as the Optical Scanning Datajack and the Retinal Clock.

Threat/Professional Rating: 6/4

Cybertechnology (FASA 7119), Chrome Kings p.89.

Kills the bearer and anyone too close. Bought at Power 3–8 and Damage Level M–D; blast −1 per meter. Kills the bearer regardless of blast size. (Rules p.47: 300,000¥ minimum.) The area bomb kills no matter where it's placed. GM may adjust the price by Damage Code; consider a minimum of 300,000¥ for the weakest. (Cybertechnology, table p.94, p.27, p.47.) As printed: Cranial Area Bomb (set to detonate upon death).
(Cybertechnology, table p.95.) As printed: Cyberears [Balance Augmentor (alpha), Hearing Amplification, Select Sound Filter (3), Sound Damper].
(Cybertechnology, table p.95.) As printed: Cybereyes (alpha) (Datajack, Flare Compensation, Low-Light, Thermographic, Optical Scanning Retinal Clock, Rangefinder, Tool Laser) (all alpha).

Independent air source: while breathing from it, immune to inhalable toxins, sleep gas and other compounds. About 20 minutes of air; refilling takes five minutes. Can be vented. (Cybertechnology, table p.97, p.41.) As printed: Internal Air Tank.

+2 Quickness, +4 Reaction, +2D6 Initiative, +2 dice for Athletics and Stealth tests. Not compatible with other Reaction/Initiative enhancers. (Cybertechnology, table p.98, p.39.) As printed: Move-By-Wire System (2) (beta).

Triggered. When activated (a light wound, a Willpower (6) Test, or an ACTH inhaler), each Level adds +1 Quickness, +1 Strength, +1 Willpower, +2 Reaction for 1D6 turns per Level (this Quickness does NOT raise Reaction). When it ends the user takes Deadly Stun — Power ½ the turns active (round down), Staging 2, resisted with Body — and cannot fire again that encounter (Shadowtech p.19).

Triggered. While active the user feels no pain: mental-damage Initiative/TN penalties are ignored and mental damage/fatigue can't knock them out, and they gain +1 Willpower but −1 Intelligence and +4 TN to tactile Perception Tests. Physical-damage penalties still apply but are hidden from the player until the editor is switched off (Shadowtech p.26). Neural bioware — inherently cultured; the listed Body Cost already includes the 25% reduction (Shadowtech p.7), so it is recorded at standard grade.
Enhanced myocardium: add Rating dice to Athletics Tests and other sustained-exertion checks (Shadowtech p.16).

Exhales a stored toxin (chosen at implantation, bought separately, +100× a dose) as a 2m cone: Quickness (4) Test to hit, +1 TN per ½m, range = ½ unaugmented Body. The user is immunized against that toxin (double natural Body to resist) (Shadowtech p.32).

Heavy anti-materiel sniper rifle with an integral silencer (+2 RR) and Smartlink I (+2). Fires custom armor-piercing rounds (treat as APDS; 200¥ per box of 10, separate acquisition test). Fields of Fire p.35.
Light pistol. Ranges are the Light Pistol row of the Weapon Range Table (p.88). SSC, restated in the core book's Sourcebook Updates table, p.278.
The smallest Morrissey holdout — an elegant polymer pistol. Cannot fire flechette or needle ammo. Street Index 2. Neo-Anarchists' Guide p.31.
An armored glove wired to dump a stunning charge into whatever it strikes (7S Stun). SSC.
SR2E p.228. Multi-edged or spiked airfoil throwing blade. Easy to conceal, fast to deploy.
A heavy, multipurpose fighting knife — equally at home dressing game or settling an argument in an alley. SSC.
